notes: Today: about 25 Jumada al-Ula 1448, no major occasion in the next 7 days. Tonight is Shab-e-Jumu'ah, so the Sadqah Short is about durood. Hadith checked against sunnah.com today: Sahih Muslim 408 (whoever sends durood once, Allah sends ten mercies) and Jami' at-Tirmidhi 1954, Hasan Sahih (whoever does not thank people does not thank Allah). The sunnah.com pages themselves could not be opened in this unattended run, so the check used sunnah.com's own search listings plus other hadith sites.

Riddle order: the 3 Nov (Riddle #5) and 4 Nov (Riddle #6) videos are still not approved, and today's video opens with Riddle #6's answer. Please approve 3 Nov, then 4 Nov, then today, so they go up in order. Or hold today's if you'd rather pause.
Riddle #7 = wolf, goat and cabbage across a river (answer for tomorrow: take the goat over; come back; take the wolf over; bring the goat back; take the cabbage over; come back; take the goat over).

All new stills are free Cloudflare FLUX images. One shot with a church spire was re-rolled, and one with half-visible faces was dropped. The Masjid-e-Nabawi shots are the real Pixabay frames (credited), not AI. The kids video is Made for Kids, and the salutation uses your recorded clip. Comments: no new threads on riddle or sadqah. Nothing was paid.
